assertions.subject: HZSM-5 microchannel reactor
assertions.claim_text: HZSM-5 microchannel reactor increases olefin selectivity by 17.9 percentage points over packed bed at 260 C.

assertions.subject: reaction temperature above 300 C
assertions.claim_text: Reaction temperature above 300 C causes rapid coke deposition on HZSM-5 beyond 48 h.

assertions.subject: feed pressure variation (1-3 atm)
assertions.claim_text: Feed pressure variation between 1 and 3 atm has no significant effect on initial turnover frequency (p = 0.42).

assertions.subject: nitrogen doping at 2.4 at%
assertions.claim_text: Nitrogen doping at 2.4 at% decreases oxygen evolution overpotential by 48 mV at 10 mA/cm^2 in 1 M KOH.

assertions.subject: amorphous carbon coating
assertions.claim_text: Amorphous carbon coating prevents cathode lattice cracking over 500 cycles at 1C.

assertions.subject: DFT-PBE+U calculation
assertions.claim_text: DFT-PBE+U calculation supports a +0.31 eV d-band center upshift on the (111) slab.

assertions.subject: Compound-K (10 uM)
assertions.claim_text: Compound-K inhibits Kinase-X phosphorylation in HeLa cells with IC50 = 1.8 uM.

assertions.subject: low-dose aspirin cohort
assertions.claim_text: Low-dose aspirin is associated with lower cardiovascular event hazard (HR = 0.84, 95% CI 0.75-0.94) in ages 55-75.

assertions.subject: Protein-B overexpression
assertions.claim_text: Protein-B overexpression activates LC3-II accumulation by 2.6-fold under 6 h serum starvation.

assertions.subject: mouse xenograft efficacy
assertions.claim_text: Translational generalization of mouse xenograft efficacy is limited by the immunocompromised host microenvironment.

assertions.subject: Sparse-Attn-v2
assertions.claim_text: Sparse-Attn-v2 outperforms Dense-Transformer by 4.2 F1 points on LongBench-32k at 7B scale.

assertions.subject: INT4 post-training quantization
assertions.object: FP16 full-precision weights on arithmetic reasoning
assertions.claim_text: INT4 post-training quantization underperforms FP16 weights by 3.1% accuracy on zero-shot GSM8K.

assertions.subject: Contrastive pretraining loss
assertions.claim_text: Contrastive pretraining performance depends on negative batch size up to B = 2048.

assertions.subject: superconducting critical temperature Tc
assertions.claim_text: Critical temperature Tc of NbTiN films is independent of substrate thickness above 50 nm (13.4 +/- 0.1 K).

assertions.subject: Theorem 2 convergence bound
assertions.conditions_and_scope: convex Lipschitz loss on compact domain
assertions.claim_text: Theorem 2 establishes an O(1/sqrt(T)) convergence rate for convex Lipschitz losses on compact domains.

assertions.subject: Pd/C hydrogenation protocol
assertions.object: 5 wt% Pd on activated carbon under 1 bar H2
assertions.claim_text: The hydrogenation protocol uses 5 wt% Pd/C under 1 bar H2 in ethanol at 25 C.

assertions.subject: in situ Raman spectroscopy data
assertions.claim_text: In situ Raman band at 842 cm^-1 contradicts the single-site mononuclear intermediate hypothesis at 0.8 V vs RHE.

assertions.subject: urban tree canopy expansion (+15%)
assertions.claim_text: A 15% urban tree canopy expansion decreases peak daytime land surface temperature by 1.9 +/- 0.4 C.

assertions.subject: prior satellite albedo estimate [Ref 14]
assertions.claim_text: Prior satellite albedo estimates associate surface darkening with Arctic amplification feedback (cited background).

assertions.subject: chain entanglement density
assertions.claim_text: Higher chain entanglement density increases elastomer tensile fracture toughness 3.4-fold at 0.1 s^-1 and 23 C.
